body:
The spinning of the event loop while handling "script" end tag says

> If this [parser has been aborted](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#abort-a-parser) in the meantime, return.

https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#parsing-main-incdata:perform-a-microtask-checkpoint:~:text=If%20this%20parser%20has%20been%20aborted%20in%20the%20meantime%2C%20return

I guess we could add that after performing the microtask checkpoint?

Also see [custom element microtask](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#parsing-main-incdata:perform-a-microtask-checkpoint:~:text=If%20the%20JavaScript%20execution%20context%20stack%20is%20empty%2C%20then%20perform%20a%20microtask%20checkpoint%2E), [custom element reactions](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#parsing-main-incdata:perform-a-microtask-checkpoint:~:text=above%2E%29-,Invoke%20custom%20element%20reactions%20in%20queue%2E), [script end tag in XML microtask](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#parsing-main-incdata:perform-a-microtask-checkpoint:~:text=When%20the%20element%27s%20end%20tag%20is%20subsequently%20parsed%2C%20the%20user%20agent%20must%20perform%20a%20microtask%20checkpoint%2C%20and%20then%20prepare%20the%20script%20element%2E). The spec doesn't say to perform a microtask checkpoint for [SVG `script`](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#parsing-main-incdata:perform-a-microtask-checkpoint:~:text=An%20end%20tag%20whose%20tag%20name%20is%20%22script%22%2C%20if%20the%20current%20node%20is%20an%20SVG%20script%20element) but maybe browsers do?

@whatwg/html-parser
